object.attr: derived: a check by other means than the history walk. It never changes a correct state, since the latest commit holds the last change's content, and it catches a wrong walk, kept state or merge reading in each surface, the gate included (CF-T21 to CF-T23, CF-T25, CF-T26, CF-T61). Compares canonical forms if MELLON-TRACE-SRS-65 is built; measure under MELLON-TRACE-SRS-110 and MELLON-TRACE-SRS-111.
object.description: Mellon shall report a link as OK only when the content of the target's object file and figure at the link's acknowledged commit equals their content at the latest commit.
